data.narrative:
The Red Metal Company is a Seed-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Jackson Switzer that has raised $10M to date. The valuation universe for frontier climate-tech includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers spanning similar subsectors, including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable valuation approach here. Using total capital raised of $10M as a proxy for Seed-stage enterprise value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $25M. Peer-median analysis cannot be reliably applied; while nine Climate & Energy peers exist in the broader dataset, none qualify as same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with sufficient overlap to derive a robust median, and broadening to all-sector peers would introduce unacceptable heterogeneity bias.

The triangulated valuation range is $21M (low) to $29M (high), with a median of $25M, anchored to a single primary method. The analysis rests heavily on the reasonableness of the 2.5x multiplier assumption for this subsector and stage. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrowly comparable Seed-stage peers, the applicability of public-market valuations to pre-revenue climate-tech, and the degree to which Red Metal's specific technology and team merit premium or discount positioning within the frontier climate cohort.
